criterion: 至少涵蓋多命令來源的排序、公平性、回應關聯與滿載，以及 IMU 多輸出之慢消費者、共享生命週期與分支容量；比較具體候選方法，不因拓撲直接要求聚合，不默認所有分支一起阻塞。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed rule/design contract case. Compliant example: Compare immediate bounded commands against batching; compare per-output copies against shared immutable samples. Choose using latency, copy and retention budgets. Required finding for the counterexample: Topology alone mandates batching or makes every output wait for the slowest one: applicability/design failure.
limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
